name: anvil-edit-development
description: Living review and planning skills for building Anvil Edit without weakening its evidence, privacy, or editor contracts.

interface.shortDescription: Build predictive editing with explicit evidence gates.
interface.longDescription: Repository-local workflows for auditing editor adapters, reviewing prediction and privacy contracts, designing staged evaluations, admitting model candidates as discovery rather than local qualification, and refreshing product guidance as the system evolves.
defaultPrompt: Audit an editor adapter or review a prediction or trace-privacy contract.
Design a reproducible predictive-editing experiment or assess a model candidate.
Refresh product documents and development skills after an authorized change.
